description: Implement a new feature following project conventions

tasks.description: Clarify what the feature should do and its acceptance criteria

prompt.template:
You are implementing a new feature. First, thoroughly understand the requirements.

## Feature Request
{{feature_name}}: {{feature_description}}

## Target Location
{{target_location}}

## Instructions
1. Analyze the feature request to understand what needs to be built
2. Identify edge cases and potential ambiguities
3. Look for similar existing features in the codebase for patterns
4. Determine integration points with existing code
5. Consider UX implications if user-facing

## Output
Provide:
- Clear acceptance criteria for the feature
- Identified edge cases to handle
- Integration points with existing code
- Any clarifying questions needed

guidance: Ask clarifying questions about edge cases
Identify integration points with existing code

tasks.description: Plan the implementation strategy and identify affected components

prompt.template:
Design the implementation approach for the feature.

## Requirements Summary
{{previous_step_output}}

## Instructions
1. Study existing patterns in the codebase
2. Identify reusable components and utilities
3. Plan the file structure and component hierarchy
4. Design for extensibility and maintainability
5. Consider testing strategy

## Output
Provide:
- Implementation plan with specific steps
- Files to create/modify
- Components to reuse
- Potential risks or challenges

guidance: Follow existing patterns in the codebase

prompt.template:
Implement the core functionality of the feature.

## Implementation Plan
{{previous_step_output}}

## Instructions
1. Create necessary files and components
2. Implement the core logic following the design
3. Write clean, well-documented code
4. Handle error cases appropriately
5. Follow project coding standards

## Output
Implement the feature and provide:
- Summary of files created/modified
- Key implementation decisions made
- Any deviations from the original plan

tasks.description: Connect the feature to existing systems

prompt.template:
Integrate the new feature with the existing codebase.

## Implementation Summary
{{previous_step_output}}

## Instructions
1. Update imports and exports as needed
2. Wire up to routing, configuration, or entry points
3. Ensure backward compatibility
4. Update any necessary documentation

## Output
Provide:
- Integration changes made
- Updated entry points
- Any configuration changes needed

guidance: Wire up to routing/configuration as needed

tasks.description: Verify the feature works as expected

prompt.template:
Test the implemented feature thoroughly.

## Integration Summary
{{previous_step_output}}

## Instructions
1. Run existing tests to check for regressions
2. Test the happy path of the new feature
3. Test edge cases and error scenarios
4. Add unit tests for new code
5. Run linting and type checking

## Output
Provide:
- Test results summary
- Any issues found and fixed
- Test coverage for new code
- Overall quality assessment

guidance: Test happy path and edge cases
Add unit tests for new code

context_requirements.hint: Existing code patterns and similar features for reference
Project coding standards and conventions documentation
